## Main Content

Wired NotebookLM into Claude Code via MCP — and Claude stopped burning tokens re-reading my PDFs.
Before: paste a wall of text into every prompt → context bloats → bill climbs.
Now: Claude pulls only the citations it needs from NotebookLM, on demand.
Less context → fewer tokens → answers grounded in your docs, not hallucinations.
4-step setup in the carousel ↗

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             Claude Code
A builder with no memory — until you feed it
knowledge

WHAT IT DOES
✅ Generate full apps, scripts, automations from a prompt
✅ Hit any HTTP API • Supabase • GitHub • Linear • Slack
✅ Run shell commands, edit files, ship real artifacts
✅ Chain tools via HTTP hooks — multi-step workflows on autopilot

WHAT IT LACKS
❌ Remember your business context between sessions
❌ Read your private PDFs • research • meeting notes
❌ Avoid hallucinating when it doesn't know your domain

POSITIONING
Claude Code is the engineer, not the librarian. Hand it a sourced
fact base — it stops guessing and starts shipping.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               The Bridge
MCP
Model Context Protocol — the universal connector

$ claude mcp add notebooklm
✓ Connected to NotebookLM workspace
→ claude can now: search · read · cite

🔍 Search
Across every doc you've uploaded
· ms latency

📎 Cite
Every answer comes back with
source-level refs

⚙️ Tool-use
NotebookLM is just another tool
Claude can call

♻️ Stateless
No copy-paste · no context-
window babysitting

WHY MCP WINS
It's not a feature — it's a protocol. Same wire format unlocks
Supabase, Pinecone, GitHub, Linear — anything that speaks MCP.

### 圖片 8

THE FULL STACK
08 / 10
Bolt on memory +
storage via MCP

KNOWLEDGE
NotebookLM — your sourced second brain

REASONING + ACTION
Claude Code — thinks, builds, automates

DATA
Supabase — persistent storage · auth · realtime

VECTOR MEMORY
Pinecone — context across sessions · recall

GLUE
HTTP Hooks — trigger workflows from any service

EMERGENT
None of these tools are new. The magic is the wiring. MCP makes
them speak one language — and you talk to all of them through
Claude.

### 圖片 9

REAL EXAMPLE
09 / 10
One prompt -> full
tracker

you@agency ~ %
claude "Read every PDF in NotebookLM. Build a competitor
tracker. Set up the DB, schedule daily updates, email me
the diff."

-> IT BUILDS, AUTOMATICALLY:

Dashboard with competitor positioning · live data

Supabase tables seeded from your research PDFs

Pinecone index storing every insight for recall

Daily alert on pricing or messaging changes

Auto-diff vs. yesterday — straight to your inbox

TIME SAVED
A 2-week build — research, schema, ingest, dashboard,
automation — collapses into one prompt and a coffee break.

### 圖片 10

SETUP RECIPE                                                               10 / 10

Ship it in 4 steps

1     Upload everything
      notebooklm.google.com → New notebook
      PDFs · research · meeting notes · slides

2     Install Claude Code
      $ npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
      Terminal or desktop · same MCP support

3     Wire MCP servers
      $ claude mcp add notebooklm supabase . . .
      One command per service · grounded online

4     Ask for a system
      $ claude "Build me a competitor tracker"
      Start small · then go bigger · compound

ONCE-AND-DONE
A 30-minute setup. Every workflow you build after that
compounds — the system gets smarter with every doc you add.
